author: National Geographic
description:
From LION to The Lion King. 

Producer and Director of National Geographic's LION Faith Musembi goes backstage at The Lion King on Broadway to learn how they’ve been bringing these iconic big cats to the stage for nearly 30 years. 

Watch LION, now streaming on Disney+ and Hulu.
See The Lion King on Broadway and on tour across the US.
